review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Department: Corporate Information Technology (CIT) Reports To: Director, IT & Cyber Security Company Overview For more than two decades, FoodChain ID has been at the forefront of the New Food industry, providing expertise worldwide to navigate the requirements of an ever-growing demand for higher levels of transparency, accountability, safety, and sustainability. Our technical and business services include serving clean label, food safety, and sustainability claims through offerings of Non-GMO Project verification, USDA Organic certification, BRC and SQF food safety certification, and more. Today, more than 30,000 companies in over 100 countries rely on our industry-leading solutions. While innovation in science and safety is still at the heart of what we do, our dedication to the technology-enablement of ourselves and our clients sets FoodChain ID apart as an industry leader. We are looking to grow our team of passionate Software, Data, and Machine Learning Engineers who are excited about using data and software to ensure the safety, transparency, and integrity of the global food chain, one client and product at a time. Position Summary The Senior Systems Engineer serves as a senior technical resource within the Corporate Information Technology team, responsible for the design, implementation, support, and continual improvement of enterprise technology platforms. This role acts as a technical escalation point, leads strategic infrastructure and security projects, mentors other engineers, and drives operational excellence across global IT services. The successful candidate combines strong technical expertise with leadership skills, project management capabilities, and a commitment to improving systems, processes, and team effectiveness. This position plays a critical role in maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable technology services while supporting business growth and cybersecurity initiatives. Key Responsibilities Systems Engineering & Technical Leadership Design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise infrastructure and cloud services Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex incidents and operational issues Lead troubleshooting efforts across infrastructure, endpoint management, Microsoft 365, identity, security, networking, and related technologies Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance security, performance, and efficiency. Project Delivery Lead and deliver strategic IT projects from planning through implementation Coordinate technology migrations, platform upgrades, and security improvement initiatives Support cross-functional projects led by other engineers and business stakeholders Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives. Security & Operational Excellence Drive initiatives that improve the organization's security posture Support endpoint management, identity management, patching, monitoring, and compliance efforts Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement and maintain security controls and best practices Identify and implement operational improvements that increase efficiency and reliability. Mentoring & Team Development Provide technical mentorship and guidance to Systems Engineers and support personnel Share knowledge through documentation, training sessions, and knowledge articles Assist in developing technical standards, procedures, and best practices Foster a culture of continuous learning and accountability. Process Ownership Take ownership of key IT processes and ensure they are documented, maintained, and continuously improved Develop and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures Participate in change management, incident management, and problem management activities Drive standardization and automation opportunities wherever possible. Stakeholder Engagement Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and technology partners Translate technical concepts into business-focused recommendations Collaborate with global teams to support enterprise initiatives and service delivery Act as a trusted technical advisor within the organization. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related IT roles Experience administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, and cloud services Experience with endpoint security platforms Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and enterprise IT operations Experience leading technical projects and infrastructure implementations Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities Excellent communication and documentation skills Preferred Qualifications Experience with monitoring solutions, and automation tools Experience with cloud platforms and hybrid environments Relevant Microsoft or cybersecurity certifications Experience supporting global organizations Success Measures Successful delivery of strategic IT projects Reduction of operational risk and technical debt Improved security posture and platform reliability Effective mentoring and development of junior engineers High-quality technical documentation and process ownership Strong stakeholder satisfaction and partnership EEO Statement FoodChain ID, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. This is a Remote position with occasional travel to the office especially in the first months. Powered by JazzHR 78BTeiQNLr

review_candidates.title: Mobile Core Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: CHI SIAMO Il 31 Dicembre 2024 Swisscom , per il tramite della propria controllata Fastweb, ha finalizzato l'acquisizione di Vodafone Italia in vista di una integrazione delle due aziende. Fastweb e Vodafone Italia da oggi lavoreranno insieme per creare un operatore convergente leader del mercato mettendo il meglio delle rispettive reti fisse e mobili e delle proprie competenze e capacità per offrire alle famiglie, alle aziende e al Paese servizi innovativi e a prezzi competitivi per continuare a promuovere la trasformazione in chiave digitale dell’Italia. Cosa troverai in Fastweb + Vodafone? WE FEEL CLOSE #belonging Insieme lavoriamo ogni giorno per creare un ambiente di lavoro informale e accogliente, in cui ogni persona possa portare il proprio contributo. Mostriamo apertura e curiosità nello sperimentare nuove soluzioni per noi e per i nostri clienti in un clima orientato alla collaborazione e al rispetto. WE ARE SMART #flexibility Smart working, autonomia nella gestione delle attività e lavoro per obiettivi. Mettiamo le relazioni e i risultati al centro e promuoviamo una cultura di empowerment e collaborazione puntando su fiducia e responsabilità. WE LEARN #impact In Fastweb + Vodafone possiamo coltivare il nostro talento. Ciascuna persona è alla guida del proprio sviluppo grazie a programmi innovativi e a percorsi professionalizzanti per costruire la propria crescita. WE FEEL GOOD #wellbeing In Fastweb + Vodafone le persone sono la nostra priorità. C’è una grande attenzione al benessere fisico e psicologico e al mantenimento di un sano work life balance, oltre alla disponibilità di tanti servizi utili, gratuiti e innovativi per semplificare la quotidianità e coltivare passioni e interessi. WE ARE UNIQUE #inclusion In Fastweb + Vodafone l’inclusione è una scelta, che rende l’ambiente positivo, dinamico e ricco di stimoli. Facciamo tesoro delle differenze perché caratterizzano noi, la nostra clientela e il mondo che ci circonda: dall’incontro delle nostre unicità nascono creatività, innovazione e crescita continua. WE ARE SUSTAINABLE #sustainability In Fastweb + Vodafone l’attenzione verso un futuro più sostenibile è un impegno quotidiano. Contribuiamo in modo concreto e misurabile al raggiungimento degli obiettivi globali, al benessere del pianeta e della società. Integriamo la sostenibilità nelle nostre attività di business, utilizzando energia elettrica proveniente al 100% da fonti rinnovabili e abilitando attraverso le nostre tecnologie la trasformazione ecologica e il superamento del digital divide. WE CARE #customer La nostra missione è conquistare nel quotidiano la fiducia e la credibilità dei nostri clienti, garantendo esperienze di valore. Il nostro impegno consiste nel realizzare servizi sempre migliori, con l'obiettivo di offrire ai clienti soluzioni che rispondano alle loro esigenze e contribuiscano a costruire un futuro migliore. CHI STIAMO CERCANDO? In Fastweb + Vodafone stiamo cercando due profili di Mobile Core Network Engineer per il Team Technology Il tuo obiettivo è contribuire alla progettazione, analisi, validazione e redazione della documentazione per lo sviluppo della Mobile Core Network Convergente di Fastweb + Vodafone e relativi servizi/architetture ancillari In un ambiente dinamico puoi metterti alla prova e incrementare le tue competenze tecniche, collaborare con diversi team aziendali e contribuire direttamente alla crescita e all'innovazione dell'azienda DESCRIZIONE DEL RUOLO In qualita’ di Mobile Core Network Engineer nel Team Technology le tue attivita’ e responsabilita’ saranno le seguenti: Progettare e sviluppare architetture e soluzioni in ambito mobile per le diverse generazioni di servizio 2G/4G/5G(NSA/SA). Definire i requisiti di servizio e condurre attività di scouting tecnologico con interazione diretta con i fornitori. Redigere la relativa documentazione tecnica. Gestire le fasi di pianificazione dei progetti, coordinando fornitori e risorse interne. Supportare le attività di validazione e rilascio in esercizio. I macro-domini di responsabilità dei vari team nell’ambito funzionale Mobile sono: Architetture Mobile Packet Core (EPC/5GC) e relativi servizi eSIM/SIM management (profili elettrici, piattaforme Over-The-Air, etc.) ed architetture Mobile Messagging Servizi Voce Mobile (VoLTE, VoWiFi) Architetture Subscriber Data Management (SDM – HLR/HSS/UDM) Architetture per la gestione dei piani di segnalazione (MAP, CAP, DIAMETER, HTTP/2) Potrai Relazionarti Con Le funzioni di business per la traduzione dei requisiti di servizio in soluzioni tecnologiche. Il team Operations per il supporto post-deployment. Il team Cybersecurity per l’analisi e l’implementazione di contromisure e tecnologie a tutela della sicurezza della rete. REQUISITI ESSENZIALI Laurea in Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni o Ingegneria Informatica. Conoscenza approfondita della rete Core LTE/EPC (MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, HSS, etc.) e buona conoscenza della rete Core 5GC (AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, UDM/AUSF, etc.). Familiarità con l’architettura service-based (SBA) del 5G SA, e i relativi protocolli (HTTP/2, RESTful API). Esperienza con tecnologie di virtualizzazione (es. VMware, KVM) e containerizzazione (Kubernetes), in ambito cloud-native. Conoscenza delle reti voce IMS e CS. Esperienza in ambito signalling 2G e 4G e relative piattaforme STP (Signaling Transfer Point) e DRA (Diameter Routing Agent). Conoscenza base dell’ecosistema terminali mobili e servizi come VoLTE. Conoscenza base nella definizione dei profili elettrici delle SIM/eSIM e relative piattaforme di gestione Over-The-Air. Conoscenza base delle architetture a supporto dei servizi di messaggistica mobile (SMSC/MMSC) e relativi protocolli di servizio (MTP, SCCP, TCAP, MAP, SMPP). Buona capacità di troubleshooting, analisi KPI, log e tracciamenti di rete. Buona conoscenza sulle tematiche di networking e dei principali protocolli Layer 2/3 (ARP, STP, RSTP, VRRP, BGP, OSPF). Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Forte orientamento al risultato. Attitudine al lavoro in team. Flessibilità, proattività e buone capacità relazionali ALTRE INFORMAZIONI Sede di lavoro: preferibilmente Milano + modalità ibrida Contratto: Tempo Indeterminato Orario: Full Time CCNL di Riferimento: Telecomunicazioni Retribuzione: da € 34.000 lordi/anno + variabile. La proposta economica finale potrà essere superiore al valore indicato e sarà definita valutando le competenze dimostrate, il livello di autonomia e l’effettivo perimetro di responsabilità assunto nel ruolo. Siamo un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed attento a garantire pari opportunità senza distinzione di genere, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, etnia, età, religione e disabilità.

review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life. The Position OPSWAT is now searching for a mid-to-senior level Joint Professional Services and Technical Support Engineer to join our Global Customer Experience team and help our customers in the UK. In the Technical Support capacity, the engineer will coordinate with colleagues in the global Support team to respond to customers’ technical queries and issues, with the goal of resolving them quickly and satisfactorily, including escalating bugs to the R&D team and managing the process to get the customer’s environment properly patched or upgraded. In the Professional Services capacity, the engineer will implement and integrate OPSWAT products and solutions purchased by customers, offer advice on best practices, provide knowledge transfer on administering the solution, and expose the customer to other OPSWAT solutions that might benefit them. The Joint Professional Services and Technical Support Engineer also works to mentor and lead others on the support team, to improve customer support processes, to maintain strong customer satisfaction, and to influence the product roadmap. As a member of a dynamic company, he or she also gets involved in other activities such as technical assistance to the Sales team, helping to test and assess new products and product releases, and other special projects. What You Will Be Doing Collaborating with the global OPSWAT Support team to resolve customer issues (which are often technical issues) rapidly and comprehensively, making sure to meet published SLAs. Working in a Technical Account Manager capacity to customers who are often very technically oriented (typical customers are engineers and IT personnel). Providing professional services for the implementation of OPSWAT products. Maintaining strong customer relationships through: Regularly scheduled conference calls to review open issues. Occasional in-person meetings Improving issue management processes within the company. Coordinating activity between Support, R&D, Product Management, and other departments. Gaining expertise (both functional and limited technical) in OPSWAT products. Going onsite and delivering professional services (training, system implementation) per request. Getting engaged in other special project activities. Understanding customer IT requirements and goals Providing advice on the use of technology to implement OPSWAT products. What We Need From You Bachelor's degree in a Computer Science, Technical discipline, or Equivalent experience. Strong knowledge of Windows and Windows server. Basic knowledge of Linux, with an interest to expand that knowledge. Good foundation and willingness to expand knowledge of networking concepts. Basic knowledge of and willingness to expand knowledge of cybersecurity and critical infrastructure protection. Strong presentation skills (be able to describe things and convey ideas to others in an easy way). A proven customer-oriented attitude, including the ability to work with difficult and/or frustrated customers. A passion for solving problems and making customers happy. Ability to think logically, analyze logs and troubleshoot computer software and IT related issues. Availability and willingness to travel as necessary to your assigned accounts, and to Company meetings. It Would Be Nice If You Had Experience working with global teams. Cybersecurity domain experience, including file security, device security, network security and etc. Network integration skillsets (e.g. Cisco, Dell-EMC, Juniper, Aruba, Ruckus, Meraki, Aerohive, Extreme, etc.). Hands-on understanding of major DevOps tools: Docker, Kubernetes (GCP GKE), CI/CD tools, Terraform, Ansible, Monitoring & Logging Tools (Zipkin, Sentry, Prometheus, ELK stack). Experience in Cloud Based Services (e.g. AWS, GCP). Experience working on Linux based infrastructure. Experience working with scripting languages such as bash script, PowerShell, and Python. Configuration and management of databases such as MySQL, Mongo. Experience in providing customer support of technical software products. This range reflects gross annual base salary only (depending on location and experience) and does not include equity or bonus. EU Compensation Range £60,000—£85,000 GBP OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws. Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

review_candidates.title: Spécialiste principal(e) des opérations d’infrastructure informatique
review_candidates.description: Job Description Et si vous pouviez redéfinir ce qui est possible? Avec nous, vous le pouvez. Avec nous, vous le pouvez. Vous recherchez un travail porteur de sens. Du développement. Des possibilités. Des collègues qui vous comprennent. Nous sommes le foyer de personnes ambitieuses, passionnées et innovantes qui façonnent le monde de demain. Grâce à une expertise inégalée en ingénierie, en services-conseils et en sciences, nos talents à l'échelle mondiale unissent leurs connaissances pour offrir des solutions locales. Nous sommes des pionniers et des créateurs d'impact. Nous sommes des Visionnaires. Nous sommes WSP. L’opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe mondiale des opérations TI qui soutient les services d'infrastructures informatiques essentiels aux activités de l’entreprise partout en Amérique du Nord. À titre de Spécialiste principal(e) des opérations d’infrastructure informatique; vous contribuerez à assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance d’une infrastructure d’entreprise complexe tout en favorisant l’amélioration continue et l’excellence opérationnelle. Votre impact Gérer des initiatives complexes et stratégiques liées aux opérations d'infrastructure informatique. Cerner des occasions d’amélioration des processus, des technologies et des méthodes de travail. Diriger le développement de méthodes opérationnelles, de techniques et d’approches analytiques. Encadrer les membres de l’équipe et soutenir la résolution d’enjeux techniques complexes. Surveiller et maintenir les services afin d’atteindre les niveaux de service établis. Effectuer les activités de maintenance préventive et les vérifications de l’état des infrastructures. Réaliser les mises à niveau et les activités d’optimisation des performances des plateformes. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux services et aux infrastructures. Planifier et exécuter les activités IMACD (installations, déplacements, ajouts, modifications et mises hors service). Réaliser des essais de continuité des activités et de résilience opérationnelle. Coordonner et soutenir les activités des fournisseurs et fabricants. Identifier et atténuer de façon proactive les risques pouvant affecter les services. Recommander et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de service. Participer aux activités de gestion des problèmes et d’analyse des causes fondamentales. Réviser et approuver les changements techniques. Soutenir les activités d’audit, de gouvernance et de conformité. Administrer et maintenir les plateformes d'infrastructure informatique. Participer à une rotation de garde et fournir un soutien en dehors des heures normales au besoin. Les compétences qui vous distinguent Qualifications Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe. La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise car l'individu participera à des initiatives internationales nécessitant une communication avec des parties prenantes anglophones. De 6 à 8 années d’expérience dans un rôle lié aux opérations d'infrastructure informatique. Excellente connaissance des services et infrastructures informatiques d’entreprise. Expérience pratique démontrée dans des environnements d’infrastructure d’entreprise. Expérience au sein de grandes organisations TI mondiales comptant plusieurs sites distribués. Expérience dans un environnement de gestion des services aligné sur les pratiques ITIL. Expérience pratique avec les technologies suivantes : Serveurs Dell et HPE. Cisco UCS. Produits VMware vCenter. Nutanix. Solutions de stockage HPE (MSA, Nimble). Technologies de mise en cache du stockage (Nasuni, Talon, Pandora). Plateformes de stockage d’objets (EMC ECS, Azure, AWS). Solutions d’archivage (Komprise, HubStore, Enterprise Vault). Solutions de sauvegarde (Veeam, Networker, DataDomain, Avamar, NetBackup, Commvault). Expérience en administration de serveurs et connaissance approfondie du matériel informatique. Expérience en administration infonuagique dans Azure et/ou AWS. Expérience des environnements serveurs Windows et Linux. Expérience avec les technologies de virtualisation telles que VMware et Hyper-V. Connaissance des principes de sécurité des serveurs, de protection des données et des exigences de conformité. Expérience en automatisation et en scripting avec PowerShell, Bash ou des outils similaires. Expérience avec les technologies SAN, NAS, RAID, la déduplication de données ainsi que les protocoles iSCSI et Fibre Channel. Connaissance des pratiques de sauvegarde, de récupération de données, de haute disponibilité et d’intégrité des données. Expérience dans la gestion des politiques de rétention et de sauvegarde des données. Expérience dans l’élaboration et la validation de stratégies de reprise respectant les objectifs RTO et RPO. Expérience en planification de reprise après sinistre, migration de données et optimisation du stockage. Capacité à optimiser la performance, la capacité et la fiabilité des infrastructures. Connaissance des technologies liées aux serveurs, au stockage et aux sauvegardes, ainsi que des tendances et exigences réglementaires du secteur. Excellentes aptitudes de communication en anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. La maîtrise du français ou de l’espagnol constitue un atout. Excellentes habiletés relationnelles et capacité à collaborer avec des intervenants à tous les niveaux. Capacité à travailler de façon autonome avec un minimum de supervision. Solides aptitudes en leadership et en coaching. Excellentes compétences en organisation, en gestion de projets et en documentation. Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de dépannage et de résolution de problèmes. Bonne compréhension des exigences de sécurité de l’information et de conformité. Expérience dans l’application des meilleures pratiques de sécurité de l’information dans les environnements d’infrastructure et d’opérations. Pourquoi choisir WSP? Chez WSP, nous façonnons les collectivités pour faire progresser l’humanité. Mettez à profit votre expertise en infrastructures Compute, en virtualisation, en stockage, en infonuagique et en excellence opérationnelle afin de soutenir des plateformes essentielles à la réussite de milliers de professionnels à travers le monde. Si vous êtes motivé(e) par les environnements complexes, l’innovation et l’amélioration continue, nous vous invitons à joindre notre équipe. review_candidates.title: Senior Performance Engineer
review_candidates.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Join NVIDIA's DGX Cloud AI Efficiency Team means advancing the performance, efficiency, and resiliency of large-scale AI workloads. We help AI researchers and platform teams understand end-to-end behavior across GPUs, networking, storage, and software stacks. We are seeking a Performance Engineer to characterize workloads, establish performance baselines, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive optimizations from investigation through deployment. Your work will shape scalable DGX Cloud systems, turn complex measurements into prioritized engineering decisions, and continuously raise the performance and reliability of AI workloads. Join our technically diverse team of infrastructure experts to unlock more efficient AI at scale. What You'll Be Doing Analyze end-to-end performance of large-scale AI workloads across compute, network, storage, and software stacks. Design and execute rigorous performance studies to establish baselines, diagnose regressions, and quantify bottlenecks. Define performance and efficiency evaluation methodologies, benchmarks, and success metrics for AI workloads. Use profiling, observability, and data analysis to turn performance measurements into actionable optimization plans. Partner with deep learning engineers, platform teams, and GPU architects to validate and deliver performance improvements. Communicate performance findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to influence system and software design decisions. What We Need To See BS or higher degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, with 12+ years of experience Strong programming skills in C++ and Python, with the ability to build reliable analysis and automation workflows Solid foundation in operating systems, computer architecture, and distributed systems Experience with performance engineering, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of complex software or systems Ability to communicate technical findings, prioritize high-impact work, and build alignment across teams Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience analyzing large-scale AI clusters or distributed training and inference workloads Experience with CUDA, GPU computing systems, and GPU performance analysis Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX/XLA Deep understanding of system-level performance analysis, workload characterization, and optimization NVIDIA leads the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions, from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. , , JR2021541

review_candidates.title: Revenue Enablement Specialist (EMEA) - 12 Month Contract
review_candidates.description: Who We Are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. Who You Are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Revenue Enablement Specialist who will drive adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement of software platforms across our Customer Success organization. In this role, you will own the Salesloft platform end-to-end — building the cadences, flows, and best practices that help CS teams work smarter and spend more time with customers. If you love technology, enablement, and making complex workflows simpler, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! What You’ll Do: As a Revenue Enablement Specialist, your key area of responsibility will be serving as the primary owner of the Salesloft platform within our Business Transformation and Enablement team — championing adoption across CS teams and building the systems that power their success. You will design and iterate on cadences tailored to CS workflows (renewals, onboarding, check-ins, and escalations), develop best-practice guides and playbooks, and track adoption metrics to surface targeted interventions where engagement is low. You will also identify manual and repetitive tasks across CS workflows and design automations that eliminate friction for reps. You will need to work closely with CS managers, RevOps, and IT/BTO to align platform configuration with evolving business needs. To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter with strong written communication skills and a knack for translating strategy into action. In addition, the successful candidate will have a solid grasp of revenue tech stacks, CRM ecosystems, and the operational needs of Customer Success and inside sales teams. How You’ll Make An Impact: Champion Salesloft adoption across CS teams through training, documentation, and hands-on support. Develop and maintain best practice guides, playbooks, and onboarding materials for new users. Track adoption metrics and identify reps or teams with low engagement; design targeted interventions. Design, build, and iterate on Salesloft cadences tailored to CS workflows (renewals, onboarding, check-ins, escalations). Collaborate with CS leadership to translate their engagement strategies into executable Salesloft sequences. Maintain a cadence library and ensure content stays current and relevant. Identify manual, repetitive tasks within CS workflows and design automations to eliminate them. Leverage Salesloft's automation rules, triggers, and integrations (e.g., Salesforce sync) to streamline rep activity. Proactively surface improvement opportunities and build a roadmap of enhancements. Partner with CS managers, RevOps, and IT/BTO to align Salesloft configuration with business needs. Maintain platform hygiene: templates, cadences, user permissions, and field mappings. Serve as the internal escalation point for Salesloft questions and issues. What You’ll Bring To This Role: Bachelor's degree in a related field 2–4 years of experience in sales/revenue enablement, sales operations, or a CS operations role Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Salesloft (building cadences, managing automations, admin tasks) as well as other revenue tech stack tools (ZoomInfo, Gong, etc.) Strong understanding of Customer Success or inside sales workflows. Data analysis skills to measure cadence performance and adoption. Excellent written communication; able to create clear, concise enablement content. Fluency in French, Portuguese, Polish, Italian, German, or Dutch is a plus. How We Work: At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. review_candidates.title: Research Account Manager, UK Education
review_candidates.description: Description Would you like to help the organisations that fund and enable UK science get more from the cloud? The UK’s central research bodies — UKRI and its Research Councils (EPSRC, MRC, BBSRC, NERC, STFC, AHRC, ESRC), the Wellcome Trust, NIHR, the Royal Society, the British Academy, and national research facilities — collectively invest billions of pounds each year in science and innovation. They fund researchers, operate world-class facilities (from the Diamond Light Source to the Hartree Centre), define data and computing strategies for entire disciplines, and set the policy frameworks that shape how research infrastructure is provisioned across the UK. Increasingly, cloud is central to their plans. The government has committed £1 billion to expand AI compute capacity 20× by 2030 through the AI Research Resource (AIRR). UKRI’s £129 million Digital Research Infrastructure programme is building a connected national fabric of compute, data, and skills. STFC operates national HPC services, Jisc provides shared digital infrastructure to the sector, and the Wellcome Trust is investing heavily in open data platforms and Trusted Research Environments. These organisations are not just users of technology — they are the architects of the UK’s research computing future. AWS wants to be their partner of choice. Amazon Web Services is seeking an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of UK central research bodies. You will be the primary commercial relationship owner for your assigned accounts — responsible for driving revenue, building pipeline, and positioning AWS as the infrastructure platform that accelerates national research outcomes. This is not about selling to individual researchers — it’s about engaging the organisations that set strategy, allocate funding, and operate shared services for the entire UK research ecosystem. The ideal candidate will understand how public-sector funding bodies and national research organisations operate — their governance structures, procurement frameworks, strategic planning cycles, and stakeholder landscapes. They should be comfortable engaging at senior executive level (CEO, COO, CIO, Director of Digital) while also building relationships with technical leaders responsible for national platforms and services. A background in public sector, research, or science and innovation policy would be a strong advantage. Key Job Responsibilities Own and manage a defined portfolio of UK central research bodies (e.g. UKRI, STFC, EPSRC, MRC, BBSRC, NERC, Wellcome Trust, NIHR, Jisc, national research facilities), driving revenue growth and AWS adoption. Develop and execute comprehensive account plans aligned to each organisation’s strategic priorities — covering national research infrastructure, data platforms, AI compute, shared services, and cloud-first policy initiatives. Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers: Chief Executives, Chief Operating Officers, CIOs, Directors of Digital, Heads of Research Infrastructure, and Procurement Directors. Understand and navigate the unique funding, governance, and procurement structures of public research bodies — including UKRI framework agreements, Wellcome Trust investment governance, and government spending controls. Identify and qualify new opportunities across national HPC services, research data platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, Trusted Research Environments, shared cloud services, and digital transformation programmes. Maintain a robust and accurate sales pipeline with clear next steps, timely CRM updates, and reliable forecasting. Create and articulate compelling value propositions that connect AWS capabilities to national research outcomes — accelerating science, improving data sharing, enabling open research, and reducing operational cost. Navigate long, complex procurement cycles involving multiple governance layers, ministerial approvals, and framework compliance (e.g. G-Cloud, CCS, JANET). Work with AWS Solution Architects, Specialist teams (HPC, AI/ML, Analytics, Storage, Security), Partners, and Professional Services to deliver technical validation and proof-of-value engagements. Engage with AWS policy and government affairs teams to align account strategies with broader UK government technology and research policy. Represent AWS at sector events to build relationships and generate demand. Track and report on pipeline, revenue, and adoption KPIs; participate in QBRs and business reviews. About The Team The AWS UK Education team is part of UK Public Sector within Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS). We work with universities, research bodies, colleges, and education technology companies across the UK to help them innovate, reduce costs, and deliver better outcomes for students and researchers. Our team combines deep sector expertise with technical credibility — we understand how the UK research ecosystem is funded, governed, and operated, and we meet our customers where they are on their cloud journey. Basic Qualifications Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development — ideally in technology, public sector, or research/science organisations Track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with long procurement timelines and governance requirements Ability to articulate technology value propositions in the context of organisational and policy outcomes Experience developing and executing account plans for strategic, high-value accounts Understanding of the UK research funding landscape — UKRI structure (Research Councils, Innovate UK, Research England), Wellcome Trust, NIHR, and how funding flows from government to researchers Familiarity with cloud concepts and their application to research — HPC, object storage, data lakes, AI/ML platforms, and secure multi-tenancy Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with national research infrastructure: STFC facilities (Diamond Light Source, ISIS, Hartree Centre), ARCHER2, JASMIN, Jisc shared services, and AIRR (Isambard-AI, Dawn) Knowledge of public sector procurement frameworks (G-Cloud, CCS, Crown Commercial Service, JANET) and government spending controls Experience working with or within UK public sector research organisations, funding bodies, or science and innovation agencies Understanding of data governance requirements in research — FAIR principles, open research mandates, Trusted Research Environments (TREs), data sovereignty, and information governance Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. review_candidates.title: Ingénieur système aéronautique (F/H)
review_candidates.description: SII Aix Méditerranée accompagne les plus grands acteurs du secteur aéronautique dans le développement et l’intégration de systèmes embarqués et de systèmes complexes. Grâce à nos expertises en ingénierie système, architecture fonctionnelle et technique, développement logiciel, ainsi qu’en essais et moyens d’essais, nous intervenons sur des programmes civils et militaires de premier plan. Vous intégrerez l’un de nos trois centres de compétences : General Engineering, System Engineering ou Test & Means, et rejoindrez une équipe qui favorisera votre montée en compétences et votre progression technique. Notre centre de services « System engineering » intervient sur l’ensemble du cycle d’ingénierie système : collecte des exigences, spécifications fonctionnelles, conception d’architectures, développement logiciel, tests unitaires et validation des évolutions. Grâce à une maîtrise poussée des méthodes MBSE, des normes aéronautiques et des réseaux avioniques, ce centre de compétences conçoit et fait évoluer les systèmes embarqués de nouvelle génération. Les nouveaux hélicoptères intègrent des systèmes et des fonctions toujours plus avancés : contrôle de vol, vehicle management, missions tactiques, situation awareness, health monitoring, connectivité sol/bord… Ces systèmes interconnectés nécessitent des moyens de communication et d’échange de données d’une grande complexité. Intégré(e) à nos équipes, vous interviendrez en ingénierie amont, sur l’ensemble du cycle de développement des systèmes embarqués de l’hélicoptère, depuis l’expression du besoin jusqu’à la certification. A Ce Titre, Vos Missions Seront Les Suivantes Spécification & conception Spécifier, concevoir et définir l’architecture fonctionnelle des systèmes embarqués. Rédiger les spécifications techniques, exigences fonctionnelles et directives d’utilisation. Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins opérationnels avec les concepteurs et experts systèmes. Validation, vérification & certification Conduire les activités de validation et vérification dans le respect des normes civiles et qualifications militaires. Participer aux processus de certification et démontrer la conformité aux réglementations applicables. Stratégie & pilotage Construire et maintenir la stratégie technique et la feuille de route des systèmes. Identifier et structurer les projets nécessaires à la mise en œuvre des roadmaps, puis piloter leur réalisation. Proposer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en intégrant les contraintes de sécurité, sûreté et certification. Coordination & communication technique Assurer le dialogue technique avec les différentes entités : avionique, architecture, essais, sûreté, certification, opérations… Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes intégrées pour garantir la cohérence technique des systèmes. Diplôme d’ingénieur en télécommunications & réseaux, systèmes embarqués, informatique industrielle ou électronique. Expérience préalable dans le développement ou l’ingénierie systèmes aéronautiques. Goût pour l’ingénierie amont, l’analyse fonctionnelle et les architectures système complexes. Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d'habilitation, conformément aux dispositions et articles du code de la défense. Notre processus de recrutement Conçu pour être rapide, transparent et équitable. Voici les étapes : Contact téléphonique (15 minutes) : Si votre CV est retenu, nous vous contacterons pour un échange téléphonique de 15 minutes. Entretien RH (1 heure) : Un rendez-vous d'une heure avec un membre de l’équipe RH pour discuter de votre parcours, de vos compétences et de ce qu’SII peut vous apporter. Entretien avec un Business Manager : Une rencontre avec un de nos business managers pour un échange plus technique et spécifique sur les missions du poste. Rencontre avec notre partenaire ou notre chef de projet : Si le poste est au sein de l'un de nos Centres de Services, un rendez-vous sera organisé avec l’un de nos chefs de projet. Sinon vous rencontrerez notre partenaire/client pour finaliser l'évaluation. Décision finale et suite du processus : Après le dernier entretien, nous vous informerons de notre décision. Si celle-ci est positive, une proposition de collaboration vous sera transmise par téléphone. En cas de non-conformité avec les attentes du client ou du chef de projet, nous vous expliquerons les raisons de l’arrêt du processus de recrutement. Nous nous engageons à vous tenir informé(e) à chaque étape du processus de recrutement. De Montpellier à Saint Tropez, SII Aix Méditerranée accompagne des acteurs majeurs comme Airbus Helicopters, Thales DIS, Naval Group, ASF, Monext, Schneider Electric ou CMA CGM dans leurs projets d’ingénierie et de transformation digitale. Nos Équipes Interviennent Sur l’ingénierie système et l’avionique, l’intégration et le support sur bancs d’essais, le développement logiciel et les tests, la gestion de projet. Un environnement propice à l’épanouissement : nous proposons des missions de long terme, un management de proximité et des évolutions sur mesure. La fidélité de nos équipes — avec une ancienneté moyenne proche de sept ans — illustre un cadre de travail qui favorise engagement, confiance et progression. Qui sommes-nous ? Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®. Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières. Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together ! Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif. En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante. Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !

Develops, implements, and tests preventative maintenance plans, interim solutions for damaged and unsafe equipment, and tooling. Investigates and documents engineering changes and controls equipment and tooling configuration in accordance with standard operating procedures. Develops and recommends equipment reliability improvements through the application of reliability engineering tooling. Education & Experience Typically requires 4 -8 years of experience Typically College or university degree required Responsibilities Lead project delivery across design, analysis, integration, and validation of automation systems; define architectures, specifications, and acceptance criteria; guide test planning, data collection, and performance verification; drive reliability engineering and maintainability improvements; manage change control, documentation, and configuration integrity; coordinate cross-functional interfaces and readiness for deployment; embed safety, quality, and compliance in solutions; mentor contributors and promote standardized practices to ensure operational excellence. Skills/ Ability Generic (High Level) Exhibit advanced proficiency in automation principles, robotics, and system integration; plan and manage scope, schedule, and risk effectively; communicate requirements and decisions with clarity; analyze complex datasets and test evidence for informed decision-making; apply reliability, maintainability, and validation methodologies; lead continuous improvement and standardization initiatives; foster collaboration across technical and operational teams. Опис посади Здійснює проєктування, аналіз, модифікацію та інтеграцію рішень у сфері робототехніки, автоматизації, технологій і процесів, пов’язаних з обладнанням та технологічним оснащенням, для їх застосування у програмах і продуктах компанії. Розробляє, впроваджує та тестує плани превентивного технічного обслуговування, а також тимчасові рішення для пошкодженого або небезпечного обладнання й оснащення. Проводить аналіз і документування інженерних змін, забезпечує контроль конфігурації обладнання та оснащення відповідно до затверджених стандартних операційних процедур. Ініціює та рекомендує заходи з підвищення надійності обладнання шляхом застосування інструментів і методологій reliability engineering. Освіта та досвід Як правило, вимагається 4–8 років релевантного професійного досвіду Повна вища освіта (ступінь бакалавра або магістра) є обов’язковою Основні обов’язки Забезпечує управління реалізацією проєктів у напрямках проєктування, аналізу, інтеграції та валідації систем автоматизації; визначає архітектуру рішень, технічні специфікації та критерії приймання. Координує процеси планування випробувань, збору даних і підтвердження експлуатаційних характеристик. Ініціює та впроваджує заходи з підвищення надійності й ремонтопридатності обладнання. Забезпечує управління змінами, ведення технічної документації та підтримання цілісності конфігурації. Координує взаємодію між функціональними командами та забезпечує готовність рішень до впровадження. Інтегрує вимоги безпеки, якості та відповідності нормативним стандартам у процес розробки рішень. Сприяє розвитку команди шляхом наставництва та впровадження стандартизованих практик для досягнення операційної ефективності. Ключові навички та компетенції Високий рівень експертизи у сфері автоматизації, робототехніки та системної інтеграції Здатність ефективно управляти обсягом робіт, термінами реалізації та ризиками Розвинені навички комунікації та структурованого формулювання вимог і рішень Досвід аналізу складних масивів даних і результатів тестувань для прийняття обґрунтованих рішень Практичне застосування методологій reliability, maintainability та validation engineering Досвід впровадження ініціатив безперервного вдосконалення та стандартизації процесів Здатність забезпечувати ефективну взаємодію між технічними та операційними командами Володіння Англійською мовою на рівні від В1+ та вижче , BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in.

review_candidates.title: Head of Global Compliance Investigations (m/f/x)
review_candidates.description: Counsel with clarity. Compliance with care. We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated compliance professional to join our Global Compliance team as Head of Compliance Investigations. In this global leadership role, you will be responsible for overseeing and further developing our global framework for managing compliance allegations and conducting internal investigations. You will ensure that concerns raised through our reporting channels are assessed, investigated and resolved in a consistent, professional, timely and fair manner. The role goes beyond conducting investigations. You will shape the strategic direction of our global investigation and allegation management framework, strengthen governance and processes, support the organization in responding to significant compliance matters, promoting a speak-up culture and contribute to the continuous development of our global Compliance Program. You will work closely with senior management, Legal, Human Resources, Internal Audit, Data Privacy, regional and local Compliance teams, as well as external counsel and forensic experts. This full‑time position is available immediately. Required travel is up to 20% per year. What You'll Do Lead and further develop the global Compliance Investigations & Allegation Management function, including governance, policies, processes, and investigation standards. Promote a strong speak-up culture and oversee the assessment, triage, allocation, and management of compliance allegations received through whistleblowing and other reporting channels. Lead and provide strategic guidance on complex, sensitive, and high-risk investigations globally, including interviews, evidence reviews, eDiscovery, reporting, and case closure. Ensure investigations are conducted independently, objectively, professionally, and in compliance with applicable laws, internal policies, and best-practice methodologies. Advise senior management and governance bodies on significant allegations, investigation outcomes, compliance risks, remediation measures, and disciplinary actions; coordinate with Legal, HR, and external experts where required. Monitor investigation outcomes and corrective actions, identify systemic risks and recurring misconduct trends, and drive continuous improvements to compliance programs, policies, controls, training, and reporting. What You’ll Bring To help you succeed, we’ll provide you with everything you need so that we’re driving impact together from day one. You’ll find a stable working environment, exceptional support, learning and development, and a great team around you. Here’s what you’ll need to bring with you: University degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field, with extensive experience in a compliance, legal, audit, or investigations role within an international organization. Proven experience conducting and managing internal investigations, compliance allegations, whistleblowing cases, and case management processes. Strong expertise in investigation methodologies, including planning, interviewing, evidence assessment, document review, reporting, remediation, and case closure. Solid understanding of key compliance risk areas, including anti-bribery and corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, competition law, trade compliance, and business integrity. Experience leading complex, sensitive, cross-border investigations, managing multiple stakeholders, jurisdictions, external law firms, forensic experts, and other advisors. Strong analytical, communication, interviewing, stakeholder management, and project management skills, with the ability to handle confidential matters with discretion, independence, and sound judgment. Fluent in English, comfortable working in international and matrix organizations, with willingness to travel globally; additional language skills are an advantage. What’s In It for You Responsibilities At Hilti, you'll join a family-owned company that thinks long term, invests in its people, and empowers individuals to make a real difference. From day one, you'll take on meaningful responsibilities, contribute to business growth, and have the opportunity to shape your own development through structured career paths and strategic growth opportunities. Some of the benefits of building your career with us include: Diverse global headquarters community of over 2,100 colleagues from 70 nationalities. Early responsibility and the opportunity to make a visible impact on business success. Long-term career growth supported by transparent development framework and career opportunities across functions, regions, and roles. Flexible and trust-based working model including remote work, workation, and sabbaticals. Relocation and family support including childcare services and integration assistance. Opportunities to contribute to social impact initiatives both locally and globally. Inclusive culture supported by more than 60 employee-led activity networks. Modern campus with onsite gym, restaurants, mobility benefits, and outdoor activities. Why Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. Commitment to Inclusion At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together. Legal Notice For further questions, please feel free to contact Jan Sprafke, Chief Compliance Officer or Hansa Stein, Talent Acquisition Business Partner. For non-EU/ EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in Switzerland/ Liechtenstein and note that if you do not own a valid Swiss/ Liechtenstein work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.

review_candidates.title: Event Producer - Northern Europe
review_candidates.description: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. As part of the Fever Originals team , you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments. About The Role We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and critical-thinking event producer based in Madrid, who will support our SSI team Fever Originals team in the Northern Europe Region in all aspects of production ensuring that high-quality experiences are delivered. This person will serve as the point of contact on the production side of all projects, being responsible for the third parties involved in the execution, development, and production of the creative deliverables for our Northern Europe Market. To support the development of new events, the Producer will research and periodically implement new production formats, technologies, and solutions that could enhance Fever’s experiences. This role may involve travel to support live launches and on-site production as we bring experiences to life across our expanding portfolio. It requires flexibility, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines while staying within budget. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in live event and/or theatrical productions, and is passionate about delivering results and producing fun and entertaining experiences for all walks of the public. Strong communication skills are critical to success in this role. The right candidate will be a self-starter and have strong interpersonal and project management skills. Responsibilities: Technical & Administrative Management Manage a range of technical and administrative processes, including pre-production logistics planning, vendor selection, and post-production wrap-up. Assess the proposed technical rider and propose eventual changes (where alternatives are required) / modifications (where permanent change is required) in line with budgetary targets. Ongoing assessment of production requirements with a goal to identify ongoing efficiencies for upcoming seasons. Budgeting Build and maintain production budgets throughout the feasibility, sign off and operational stages of production. Ongoing monitoring of local operational spends and identifying of optimization opportunities Invoice management and closing of the event P&Ls Partner Management Lead the due diligence on the key partners and suppliers Develop long term deals with national scope to facilitate the geographical expansion of the project Qualifications You have a track record of successfully produced events with strong data analysis, oral and written communication skills. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and pride yourself on your flexible, detailed, analytical mindset. The role requires a mix of business development and operational experience. Candidates need to be passionate about the entertainment/events industry. You will have to be comfortable delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-orientated while looking around corners, and thinking bigger about how we create a compelling experience. 3+ years of experience in the event production industry. Fluent English and preferably one of 5 Nordic Languages (Dutch, Finnish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian) Ability to manage multiple projects at any given time and pull together multiple aspects of an event in an organized and efficient way Have a strong network of vendors and venues Understanding of technical production requirements Familiarity with permitting processes Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly Have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences. Benefits and Perks: Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences Health and dental insurance Gympass membership Work in a location in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets Home office friendly Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with! Our hiring process A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit, and answer any questions you may have A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics, and written understanding A 30 min interview with your future manager A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance) This role is based in Madrid Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

review_candidates.title: Event Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: Role: Event Operations Manager Location: Remote (LATAM-based welcome), with regular travel to the United States required to support on-site events ABOUT COSIGN Cosign is the fastest growing prop-tech company in the United States revolutionizing the $4 trillion rental industry with a market-leading one-of-a-kind rent guarantee product. Our mission is to expand housing access for renters and boost occupancy for landlords. Backed by top entrepreneurs, venture capital firms, and real estate investors, Cosign is built by experienced landlords and managers for landlords and managers who deeply understand the rental market’s needs. OUR MISSION CONTINUED Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters - without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We’re building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify - expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases. OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity - individuals who: • Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement • Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues • Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize • Create innovative solutions others believe impossible We deliberately seek these rare, high-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard. We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence. THE OPPORTUNITY Calling all logistics obsessives and client-experience builders. We are looking for a hands-on, detail-driven, and proactive Event Operations Manager to own end-to-end logistics for our client-facing events and travel program from the ground up, supporting 100+ events per year. This is a founding operations role where you will own every piece of getting the team where they need to be, prepared, and ready to represent Cosign in front of clients and partners. As the first dedicated hire in this seat, you will own the entire stack: travel booking, event calendaring, agenda communication, client dinners and activities, booth installation and supervision, partner billing coordination, and ad-hoc gifting. You will work directly with Sales Operations and leadership to turn client-facing events into a well-oiled, high-touch operation, with every event tied to a seamless client experience. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, has run high-volume event and travel logistics before, is comfortable owning vendor and partner relationships end-to-end, and is excited to own this function in a fast-moving, early-stage context. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Own the events and travel logistics engine across the business: booking flights, hotels, and rental cars for team members attending 100+ events per year, well ahead of each event date. • Maintain a rolling calendar of all events, tracking booking deadlines, confirmations, and any changes, and sending the team a clear pre-event agenda ahead of every event. • Coordinate directly with the Sales Operations team to align event logistics with account and pipeline priorities. • Serve as the point person for all client-related activities - every client touchpoint at an event runs through this role. • Plan and facilitate company events, activities and dinners end-to-end, including setting up invites via Luma/Partiful. • Evaluate restaurant options and activity ideas for client dinners and outings, balancing quality, location, and budget. • Correspond with partner companies on billing and logistics for co-hosted or co-sponsored events. • Own ad-hoc client and team gifting end-to-end - sourcing, ordering, and ensuring timely delivery. • A function that flexes with the business: stepping into adjacent client-experience and ad hoc projects as needed in an early-stage, fast-moving environment. • Maintain a detailed, structured expenditure ledger to ensure seamless financial reconciliation with the accounting team. ABOUT YOU As a highly organized and detail-driven Event Operations Manager, you take full ownership of events, travel, and accommodations, from initial booking through final send-off, without needing direction. You are deeply committed to getting every detail right, remain structured under pressure, and never let a booking deadline or client touchpoint slip. You thrive in early-stage landscapes where processes are still evolving. Instead of seeing gaps as obstacles, you view them as chances to build better systems, bring fresh ideas, and find energy in constructing something new rather than simply working inside it. You are a logistics and client-experience wizard, comfortable running multiple bookings and events at once, owning vendor and partner relationships, and making sure every client interaction feels seamless and well thought out. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE We are looking for a passionate, experienced operator who is excited about building a client-events function that has never been built before. • 3+ years of experience in event planning, travel coordination, executive support, or client experience roles; startup, proptech, fintech, or insurtech experience is a plus but not necessary • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent bookings and deadlines without dropping details • Comfortable owning vendor and partner relationships, including billing and invoicing conversations • Strong written communication - comfortable sending clear, well-organized agendas and updates to a team • Experience with event platforms like Luma or Partiful, or similar tools, is a plus • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and calm under pressure when plans change last minute • Willingness to travel frequently, including internationally, to support on-site events • Must have current authorization to travel to the United States (e.g., a valid U.S. visitor visa or visa-free entry eligibility), and be able to maintain that authorization, as regular U.S. travel is a core requirement of this role WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will play a direct role in shaping how Cosign shows up for clients and partners in person, helping housing providers create better experiences for residents, renters, and property teams across the country. You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, have direct access to senior leadership, and have real ownership over outcomes from day one. We move fast, we take care of our people, and we are building something that genuinely matters. WORKING AT COSIGN This is a remote position, with regular travel to the United States required to support major on-site events throughout the year. Cosign is looking for someone who is comfortable operating with pace, accountability, and a high degree of ownership. The right person will be energized by the opportunity to build structure within a growing business and create a lasting impact on how its client events run.

review_candidates.title: Distribution Sales Manager - Southern Europe
review_candidates.description: ConnectWise is an industry and Global leading software company with over 3,000 colleagues in North America, EMEA and APAC. As a community-driven software company dedicated to the success of technology solution providers, our suite helps over 45,000 of our partners manage their businesses better, sell more efficiently, automate service delivery, and remotely control technology so they can consistently deliver amazing customer experiences. Our company is powered by our connections, our colleagues, and our community. And, we accept all kinds. Game-changers, innovators, culture-lovers—and humankind. We invite discovery and debate. We recognize key moments as milestones. We see you and value you for your unique contributions. Our inclusive, positive culture lays the foundation to ensure every colleague is valued for their perspectives and skills, giving you the choice of how YOU make a difference. Curious? Read this opportunity to learn how YOU can make a difference at ConnectWise! Fluence in Italian or Spanish is essential for this role. General Summary: The Distributor Sales Manager owns the strategic, commercial and operational relationship between ConnectWise and its authorized distributors across the EMEA region, driving indirect revenue growth through strategic distributor engagement and joint business planning for his assigned Distributors. The role is accountable for distributor alignment, performance, enablement, and governance, ensuring each distributor is positioned to successfully recruit, support, and grow MSP partners on the ConnectWise platform.
