new_matches.description: CHI SIAMO Il 31 Dicembre 2024 Swisscom , per il tramite della propria controllata Fastweb, ha finalizzato l'acquisizione di Vodafone Italia in vista di una integrazione delle due aziende. Fastweb e Vodafone Italia da oggi lavoreranno insieme per creare un operatore convergente leader del mercato mettendo il meglio delle rispettive reti fisse e mobili e delle proprie competenze e capacità per offrire alle famiglie, alle aziende e al Paese servizi innovativi e a prezzi competitivi per continuare a promuovere la trasformazione in chiave digitale dell’Italia. Cosa troverai in Fastweb + Vodafone? WE FEEL CLOSE #belonging Insieme lavoriamo ogni giorno per creare un ambiente di lavoro informale e accogliente, in cui ogni persona possa portare il proprio contributo. Mostriamo apertura e curiosità nello sperimentare nuove soluzioni per noi e per i nostri clienti in un clima orientato alla collaborazione e al rispetto. WE ARE SMART #flexibility Smart working, autonomia nella gestione delle attività e lavoro per obiettivi. Mettiamo le relazioni e i risultati al centro e promuoviamo una cultura di empowerment e collaborazione puntando su fiducia e responsabilità. WE LEARN #impact In Fastweb + Vodafone possiamo coltivare il nostro talento. Ciascuna persona è alla guida del proprio sviluppo grazie a programmi innovativi e a percorsi professionalizzanti per costruire la propria crescita. WE FEEL GOOD #wellbeing In Fastweb + Vodafone le persone sono la nostra priorità. C’è una grande attenzione al benessere fisico e psicologico e al mantenimento di un sano work life balance, oltre alla disponibilità di tanti servizi utili, gratuiti e innovativi per semplificare la quotidianità e coltivare passioni e interessi. WE ARE UNIQUE #inclusion In Fastweb + Vodafone l’inclusione è una scelta, che rende l’ambiente positivo, dinamico e ricco di stimoli. Facciamo tesoro delle differenze perché caratterizzano noi, la nostra clientela e il mondo che ci circonda: dall’incontro delle nostre unicità nascono creatività, innovazione e crescita continua. WE ARE SUSTAINABLE #sustainability In Fastweb + Vodafone l’attenzione verso un futuro più sostenibile è un impegno quotidiano. Contribuiamo in modo concreto e misurabile al raggiungimento degli obiettivi globali, al benessere del pianeta e della società. Integriamo la sostenibilità nelle nostre attività di business, utilizzando energia elettrica proveniente al 100% da fonti rinnovabili e abilitando attraverso le nostre tecnologie la trasformazione ecologica e il superamento del digital divide. WE CARE #customer La nostra missione è conquistare nel quotidiano la fiducia e la credibilità dei nostri clienti, garantendo esperienze di valore. Il nostro impegno consiste nel realizzare servizi sempre migliori, con l'obiettivo di offrire ai clienti soluzioni che rispondano alle loro esigenze e contribuiscano a costruire un futuro migliore. CHI STIAMO CERCANDO? In Fastweb + Vodafone stiamo cercando due profili di Mobile Core Network Engineer per il Team Technology Il tuo obiettivo è contribuire alla progettazione, analisi, validazione e redazione della documentazione per lo sviluppo della Mobile Core Network Convergente di Fastweb + Vodafone e relativi servizi/architetture ancillari In un ambiente dinamico puoi metterti alla prova e incrementare le tue competenze tecniche, collaborare con diversi team aziendali e contribuire direttamente alla crescita e all'innovazione dell'azienda DESCRIZIONE DEL RUOLO In qualita’ di Mobile Core Network Engineer nel Team Technology le tue attivita’ e responsabilita’ saranno le seguenti: Progettare e sviluppare architetture e soluzioni in ambito mobile per le diverse generazioni di servizio 2G/4G/5G(NSA/SA). Definire i requisiti di servizio e condurre attività di scouting tecnologico con interazione diretta con i fornitori. Redigere la relativa documentazione tecnica. Gestire le fasi di pianificazione dei progetti, coordinando fornitori e risorse interne. Supportare le attività di validazione e rilascio in esercizio. I macro-domini di responsabilità dei vari team nell’ambito funzionale Mobile sono: Architetture Mobile Packet Core (EPC/5GC) e relativi servizi eSIM/SIM management (profili elettrici, piattaforme Over-The-Air, etc.) ed architetture Mobile Messagging Servizi Voce Mobile (VoLTE, VoWiFi) Architetture Subscriber Data Management (SDM – HLR/HSS/UDM) Architetture per la gestione dei piani di segnalazione (MAP, CAP, DIAMETER, HTTP/2) Potrai Relazionarti Con Le funzioni di business per la traduzione dei requisiti di servizio in soluzioni tecnologiche. Il team Operations per il supporto post-deployment. Il team Cybersecurity per l’analisi e l’implementazione di contromisure e tecnologie a tutela della sicurezza della rete. REQUISITI ESSENZIALI Laurea in Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni o Ingegneria Informatica. Conoscenza approfondita della rete Core LTE/EPC (MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, HSS, etc.) e buona conoscenza della rete Core 5GC (AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, UDM/AUSF, etc.). Familiarità con l’architettura service-based (SBA) del 5G SA, e i relativi protocolli (HTTP/2, RESTful API). Esperienza con tecnologie di virtualizzazione (es. VMware, KVM) e containerizzazione (Kubernetes), in ambito cloud-native. Conoscenza delle reti voce IMS e CS. Esperienza in ambito signalling 2G e 4G e relative piattaforme STP (Signaling Transfer Point) e DRA (Diameter Routing Agent). Conoscenza base dell’ecosistema terminali mobili e servizi come VoLTE. Conoscenza base nella definizione dei profili elettrici delle SIM/eSIM e relative piattaforme di gestione Over-The-Air. Conoscenza base delle architetture a supporto dei servizi di messaggistica mobile (SMSC/MMSC) e relativi protocolli di servizio (MTP, SCCP, TCAP, MAP, SMPP). Buona capacità di troubleshooting, analisi KPI, log e tracciamenti di rete. Buona conoscenza sulle tematiche di networking e dei principali protocolli Layer 2/3 (ARP, STP, RSTP, VRRP, BGP, OSPF). Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Forte orientamento al risultato. Attitudine al lavoro in team. Flessibilità, proattività e buone capacità relazionali ALTRE INFORMAZIONI Sede di lavoro: preferibilmente Milano + modalità ibrida Contratto: Tempo Indeterminato Orario: Full Time CCNL di Riferimento: Telecomunicazioni Retribuzione: da € 34.000 lordi/anno + variabile. La proposta economica finale potrà essere superiore al valore indicato e sarà definita valutando le competenze dimostrate, il livello di autonomia e l’effettivo perimetro di responsabilità assunto nel ruolo. Siamo un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed attento a garantire pari opportunità senza distinzione di genere, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, etnia, età, religione e disabilità.

new_matches.description: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life. The Position OPSWAT is now searching for a mid-to-senior level Joint Professional Services and Technical Support Engineer to join our Global Customer Experience team and help our customers in the UK. In the Technical Support capacity, the engineer will coordinate with colleagues in the global Support team to respond to customers’ technical queries and issues, with the goal of resolving them quickly and satisfactorily, including escalating bugs to the R&D team and managing the process to get the customer’s environment properly patched or upgraded. In the Professional Services capacity, the engineer will implement and integrate OPSWAT products and solutions purchased by customers, offer advice on best practices, provide knowledge transfer on administering the solution, and expose the customer to other OPSWAT solutions that might benefit them. The Joint Professional Services and Technical Support Engineer also works to mentor and lead others on the support team, to improve customer support processes, to maintain strong customer satisfaction, and to influence the product roadmap. As a member of a dynamic company, he or she also gets involved in other activities such as technical assistance to the Sales team, helping to test and assess new products and product releases, and other special projects. What You Will Be Doing Collaborating with the global OPSWAT Support team to resolve customer issues (which are often technical issues) rapidly and comprehensively, making sure to meet published SLAs. Working in a Technical Account Manager capacity to customers who are often very technically oriented (typical customers are engineers and IT personnel). Providing professional services for the implementation of OPSWAT products. Maintaining strong customer relationships through: Regularly scheduled conference calls to review open issues. Occasional in-person meetings Improving issue management processes within the company. Coordinating activity between Support, R&D, Product Management, and other departments. Gaining expertise (both functional and limited technical) in OPSWAT products. Going onsite and delivering professional services (training, system implementation) per request. Getting engaged in other special project activities. Understanding customer IT requirements and goals Providing advice on the use of technology to implement OPSWAT products. What We Need From You Bachelor's degree in a Computer Science, Technical discipline, or Equivalent experience. Strong knowledge of Windows and Windows server. Basic knowledge of Linux, with an interest to expand that knowledge. Good foundation and willingness to expand knowledge of networking concepts. Basic knowledge of and willingness to expand knowledge of cybersecurity and critical infrastructure protection. Strong presentation skills (be able to describe things and convey ideas to others in an easy way). A proven customer-oriented attitude, including the ability to work with difficult and/or frustrated customers. A passion for solving problems and making customers happy. Ability to think logically, analyze logs and troubleshoot computer software and IT related issues. Availability and willingness to travel as necessary to your assigned accounts, and to Company meetings. It Would Be Nice If You Had Experience working with global teams. Cybersecurity domain experience, including file security, device security, network security and etc. Network integration skillsets (e.g. Cisco, Dell-EMC, Juniper, Aruba, Ruckus, Meraki, Aerohive, Extreme, etc.). Hands-on understanding of major DevOps tools: Docker, Kubernetes (GCP GKE), CI/CD tools, Terraform, Ansible, Monitoring & Logging Tools (Zipkin, Sentry, Prometheus, ELK stack). Experience in Cloud Based Services (e.g. AWS, GCP). Experience working on Linux based infrastructure. Experience working with scripting languages such as bash script, PowerShell, and Python. Configuration and management of databases such as MySQL, Mongo. Experience in providing customer support of technical software products. This range reflects gross annual base salary only (depending on location and experience) and does not include equity or bonus. EU Compensation Range £60,000—£85,000 GBP OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws. Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

Amazon Web Services is seeking an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of UK central research bodies. Identify and qualify new opportunities across national HPC services, research data platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, Trusted Research Environments, shared cloud services, and digital transformation programmes. Maintain a robust and accurate sales pipeline with clear next steps, timely CRM updates, and reliable forecasting. Work with AWS Solution Architects, Specialist teams (HPC, AI/ML, Analytics, Storage, Security), Partners, and Professional Services to deliver technical validation and proof-of-value engagements. Our team is responsible for developing and managing relationships with the global and regional banks that enable the Stripe product strategy and deliver new capabilities to Stripe users. Our team executes on high-impact, cross-functional product partnership initiatives across existing products and early-stage "up the stack" financial products. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and are essential for us to offer products used by millions of our users. What you'll do We're looking for a Partner Development Manager to join the Financial Partnerships team. You'll be responsible for developing and executing the multi-year, global strategies for building our relationships across many of our most important banking partners. You'll focus on designing, scaling, and continuously improving mechanisms to deepen relationships with our partners, as well as highly impactful programs key to differentiating Stripe. As part of these efforts, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, etc.), and with the banking partners' executive teams. The successful candidate will have a demonstrated ability to manage and develop partners, think strategically and apply diagnostic thinking to business, product, and technical challenges, and earn trust with and influence others. Responsibilities Develop the go-to-partner strategy and execute on our most ambitious company-bending, bank-network-driven projects that are global and cross-border in nature Own the banking partner plans, the overall economics, day-to-day operational excellence, and be responsible for driving the partnerships to successful outcomes for Stripe Leverage banking, treasury, and payments industry knowledge to craft thoughtful partnership and product strategies with transaction banks, lenders, capital markets, central banks, and schemes Navigate, in partnership with Product, to execute deals supporting that strategy and help ensure a proper execution plan is in place Leverage significant industry experience to educate and help internal teams compose our holistic bank-led strategy and to advance that strategy with banking partners Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. new_matches.title: Ingénieur système aéronautique (F/H)

Grâce à nos expertises en ingénierie système, architecture fonctionnelle et technique, développement logiciel, ainsi qu’en essais et moyens d’essais, nous intervenons sur des programmes civils et militaires de premier plan. Vous intégrerez l’un de nos trois centres de compétences : General Engineering, System Engineering ou Test & Means, et rejoindrez une équipe qui favorisera votre montée en compétences et votre progression technique. Notre centre de services « System engineering » intervient sur l’ensemble du cycle d’ingénierie système : collecte des exigences, spécifications fonctionnelles, conception d’architectures, développement logiciel, tests unitaires et validation des évolutions. Grâce à une maîtrise poussée des méthodes MBSE, des normes aéronautiques et des réseaux avioniques, ce centre de compétences conçoit et fait évoluer les systèmes embarqués de nouvelle génération. Les nouveaux hélicoptères intègrent des systèmes et des fonctions toujours plus avancés : contrôle de vol, vehicle management, missions tactiques, situation awareness, health monitoring, connectivité sol/bord… Ces systèmes interconnectés nécessitent des moyens de communication et d’échange de données d’une grande complexité. Intégré(e) à nos équipes, vous interviendrez en ingénierie amont, sur l’ensemble du cycle de développement des systèmes embarqués de l’hélicoptère, depuis l’expression du besoin jusqu’à la certification. A Ce Titre, Vos Missions Seront Les Suivantes Spécification & conception Spécifier, concevoir et définir l’architecture fonctionnelle des systèmes embarqués. Rédiger les spécifications techniques, exigences fonctionnelles et directives d’utilisation. Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins opérationnels avec les concepteurs et experts systèmes. Validation, vérification & certification Conduire les activités de validation et vérification dans le respect des normes civiles et qualifications militaires. Participer aux processus de certification et démontrer la conformité aux réglementations applicables. Stratégie & pilotage Construire et maintenir la stratégie technique et la feuille de route des systèmes. Identifier et structurer les projets nécessaires à la mise en œuvre des roadmaps, puis piloter leur réalisation. Proposer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en intégrant les contraintes de sécurité, sûreté et certification. Coordination & communication technique Assurer le dialogue technique avec les différentes entités : avionique, architecture, essais, sûreté, certification, opérations… Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes intégrées pour garantir la cohérence technique des systèmes. Diplôme d’ingénieur en télécommunications & réseaux, systèmes embarqués, informatique industrielle ou électronique. Expérience préalable dans le développement ou l’ingénierie systèmes aéronautiques. Goût pour l’ingénierie amont, l’analyse fonctionnelle et les architectures système complexes. Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d'habilitation, conformément aux dispositions et articles du code de la défense. Notre processus de recrutement Conçu pour être rapide, transparent et équitable. Voici les étapes : Contact téléphonique (15 minutes) : Si votre CV est retenu, nous vous contacterons pour un échange téléphonique de 15 minutes. Entretien RH (1 heure) : Un rendez-vous d'une heure avec un membre de l’équipe RH pour discuter de votre parcours, de vos compétences et de ce qu’SII peut vous apporter. Entretien avec un Business Manager : Une rencontre avec un de nos business managers pour un échange plus technique et spécifique sur les missions du poste. Rencontre avec notre partenaire ou notre chef de projet : Si le poste est au sein de l'un de nos Centres de Services, un rendez-vous sera organisé avec l’un de nos chefs de projet. Sinon vous rencontrerez notre partenaire/client pour finaliser l'évaluation. Décision finale et suite du processus : Après le dernier entretien, nous vous informerons de notre décision. Si celle-ci est positive, une proposition de collaboration vous sera transmise par téléphone. En cas de non-conformité avec les attentes du client ou du chef de projet, nous vous expliquerons les raisons de l’arrêt du processus de recrutement. Nous nous engageons à vous tenir informé(e) à chaque étape du processus de recrutement. De Montpellier à Saint Tropez, SII Aix Méditerranée accompagne des acteurs majeurs comme Airbus Helicopters, Thales DIS, Naval Group, ASF, Monext, Schneider Electric ou CMA CGM dans leurs projets d’ingénierie et de transformation digitale. Nos Équipes Interviennent Sur l’ingénierie système et l’avionique, l’intégration et le support sur bancs d’essais, le développement logiciel et les tests, la gestion de projet. Un environnement propice à l’épanouissement : nous proposons des missions de long terme, un management de proximité et des évolutions sur mesure. La fidélité de nos équipes — avec une ancienneté moyenne proche de sept ans — illustre un cadre de travail qui favorise engagement, confiance et progression. Qui sommes-nous ? Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®. Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières. Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together ! Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif. En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante. Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !
